This got me. 

I'm reminded of the quote:

"If you have come here to help me, you are wasting your time. But if you have come because your liberation is bound up with mine, then let us work together.”

May we free ourselves in service of others.

This election won’t be about left and right, it will be about right and wrong.

For 250 years Americans have stood up and spoke up against the powerful, we have to do the same this November and hold President Trump accountable.

The boss is speaking truth to power – calling out the nightmare at Delaney Hall. He’s shining a light on the suffering in this for-profit facility and Trump’s cruelty that’s tearing families apart.

I‘ve met these detainees–our neighbors, small business owners, high school athletes. I met the mother ripped from her newborn American baby, denied proper medical care.

This is a moral stain on our nation.

This was never about you. 
It was always about him.

The elections this November are a moral moment in America.

We need a Congress that will hold Trump accountable and deliver for the American people.

What a heartwarming moment when a woman encourages this man to let his inner child out, to run through sprinklers and ultimately beat the heat. 

May we all encourage more, help more, and never lose the part of us that still wants to run through the sprinklers.

The American people know the truth: Trump’s policies are making them sicker and poorer. Families can't keep up with the cost of groceries, healthcare, and gas because of Trump’s chaos, cruelty and corruption. 

Together we must fight to redeem the American dream for working families.

Delaney Hall needs to be closed now. This nightmare needs to end now.

Trump’s vanity projects are a monument to his ego, built on the backs of struggling families.

At Delaney Hall I met with a woman who was taken from her newborn baby, an American, who was not getting the proper medical care she needed.

This for-profit facility and Trump’s cruelty is a moral stain on our community and nation.

Instead of protecting Americans, Trump’s cruelty and chaos is allowing corporations to profit off of people’s pain.

We must close Delaney Hall.

I am deeply disturbed and outraged by the rapid escalation overnight at Delaney Hall, especially with video emerging that appears to show an ICE agent striking a protester with a baton into what seemed to be a moving 18‑wheeler truck. On Wednesday, during my visit, I spoke directly with DHS staff about the need for de‑escalation tactics. Delaney Hall is run by GEO Group under a 15-year, $1 billion contract. That’s not public safety. That’s a private corporation, giving $$$ to Tump's campaign and then getting rich off human suffering, all with a documented history of neglect and abuse.

We’re paying a corporation to warehouse our neighbors. The people inside Delaney Hall are overwhelmingly not charged with any crime. In my visit, I talked with people who have American families, children, and even grandchildren.

Reports of violent assaults on police officers scrubbed away as 'partisan propaganda' while funneling billions into Trump’s billion dollar slush fund for his allies and possibly January 6 rioters. This gross misuse of taxpayer dollars is one of the most brazen acts of corruption in our history.
